reason: I already have a LARQ that works fine. My problem is forgetting it, not the bottle itself, so a $68 bottle plus a filter subscription from a brand I've never heard of doesn't fix anything for me.
objection: How do I know the filter actually does anything? 'Up to 150 L' is the supplier's rating, and I don't see any test results showing what it removes.
would_change_my_mind: Independent lab results or a certification showing what the filter removes, plus a no-questions return so I could try it against my LARQ.
